title: GRPO-CARE: Consistency-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Reasoning

layout.note: A wide left half holds the benchmark: a large Level-1 card above a smaller Level-2 card and Level-3 card, with a title below; a narrower right half holds the results: a dotted box of four small bar charts above two stacked reasoning bubbles, with a title below; a curved arrow links the Level-1 card to the bubbles.

lesson: Pair a benchmark panel and a results panel in one teaser: ordered level cards with one record drawn in full on the left, paired bars with red gain brackets above two reasoning bubbles marked with a cross and a check on the right, so the numbers and one concrete failure are read together.
